implementation.procedureAnchor: Agent procedure: design the concurrent-learning loop and decide the evidence required to advance each stage.
implementation.outputAnchor: Return iteration scope, parameter and machine plans, uncertainty thresholds, labeling criteria, and stopping rules.
implementation.failureAnchor: Stop when data provenance, exploration domain, labeling fidelity, or convergence criteria are undefined.

implementation.usageAnchor: Use the user-configured dpgen CLI only for an explicitly reviewed init, run, autotest, simplify, or collect operation.
implementation.authorityAnchor: The user owns DP-GEN, training and labeling runtimes, scheduler configuration, credentials, compute budget, and every submitted job.
implementation.failureAnchor: If a stage or backend fails, preserve its artifacts and logs and ask whether to repair or rerun; never resubmit automatically.

implementation.procedureAnchor: Agent procedure: review model deviation, selected configurations, label quality, coverage, and convergence before proposing another iteration.
implementation.outputAnchor: Return a stage ledger, accepted/rejected structures, evidence gaps, and advance/stop recommendation.
implementation.failureAnchor: Do not advance when uncertainty, labeling errors, data leakage, or unexplored regions invalidate the iteration.
